items.title: AIOHTTPにおける制限またはスロットリング無しのリソースの割り当てに関する脆弱性
items.body: AIOHTTPは、asyncioおよびPython向けの非同期HTTPクライアント/サーバーフレームワークです。バージョン3.14.4以前では、WebSocketリーダーが不完全なフレームを再構築する際に、各トランスポート読み取りごとに1つのバイトオブジェクトを保持していました。悪意のあるピアはフレームを非常に小さな読み取りに分割できるため、個々のオブジェクトのオーバーヘッドがmax_msg_sizeで許可されたペイロードバイト数を大幅に超過してしまいます。この状況は、悪意のあるクライアントからフレームを受信するサーバーおよび悪意のあるサーバーからフレームを受信するクライアントの両方に影響を及ぼし、過剰なメモリ消費やサービス拒否（DoS）を引き起こす可能性があります。この問題はバージョン3.14.4で修正されています。

Attackers can craft Special:Ask links using request_type=special_page so export output renders as text/html, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers under the wiki origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-130787 - Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ...
items.body: Frappe ERPNext before 16.35.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in financial reporting endpoints that allows low-privilege authenticated users to generate reports outside their permitted scope. Attackers can send crafted requests to affected reporting endpoints to read other companies' tax and payment data, including personal and corporate identifiers and financial totals.

items.title: CVE-2026-130786 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a configuration injection vulnerability that allows users who can launch instances from controlled images to inject LXC directives by embedding line breaks in OCI config.json values or oci.entrypoint and oci.cwd keys. Attackers can add liblxc hooks or crafted tmpfs lxc.mount.entry fields to run commands as root on the host or bind-mount host paths, even from restricted projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130785 - Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in...
items.body: Incus from 7.3.0 before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest API that allows a process in one container to impersonate another by creating a cgroup named with a forged lxc.monitor. component. Attackers can read the target container's user.* and cloud-init.* configuration and devices, subscribe to its events, mark it ready, and export images across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130784 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows re...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted clients to create and access default project resources by exploiting entitlement checks against the requested project. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq directives to execute code as root on the host, or manipulate inherited resources via the ?project= parameter.

items.title: CVE-2026-130783 - Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through th...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 exposes certificate and cluster join token secrets through the default project event stream and skips authorization when cancelling operations without associated permissions. Restricted clients can subscribe to operation events to capture certificate tokens and enroll unrestricted certificates, gaining full server access, or cancel token operations by UUID.

items.title: CVE-2026-130782 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted and view-only clients to read default project resources by requesting the default project directly. Attackers knowing resource names can read profiles, images, network zone peer keys and stored credentials, and export custom volume or bucket backups to obtain full contents or S3 admin keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-130781 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage b...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the storage bucket S3 listener, which buffers entire signed request bodies in memory before verifying the signature or credential role. Attackers knowing only a valid access key, or holding a read-only credential, can send many concurrent large requests to exhaust daemon memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-130780 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows malicious migration peers to write outside intended directories by supplying unvalidated dependent volume and snapshot names in the migration offer header. Attackers controlling a migration source can create root-owned volumes with attacker content at arbitrary host paths, compromising hosts using dir storage pools, bypassing restricted.storage-pools.access, or crashing the daemon.

items.title: CVE-2026-130779 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users per...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows users permitted to import custom volumes to store unvalidated snapshot names from the backup index configuration section. Attackers can craft a backup with traversal sequences in snapshot names so later deletion removes arbitrary host directories as root, while renaming or mounting operates on arbitrary paths.

items.title: CVE-2026-130778 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows r...

Attackers can append the server's or a cluster member's certificate to gain cluster-level access, bypass authorization, modify trust store entries, and influence scriptlet-based authorization decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-130777 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project-restricted authenticated clients to receive other projects' OVN ACL logs because these events are broadcast with an empty project. Attackers can subscribe to network-acl events on one accessible project to observe internal IPs, ports, protocols, and allow/drop decisions across all projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130776 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows clients with project event-view access to read migration websocket secrets broadcast in operation metadata. Attackers can connect to in-flight migration control and fs websockets before the legitimate peer, hijacking the transfer to obtain instance configuration and filesystem data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130775 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/in...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /dev/incus guest-API image export handler that fails to pin the project parameter to the guest's own project. Container root users with the guest-API image entitlement can supply another project in the project query parameter to export public or cached images, including non-public images pulled from authenticated remotes.

items.title: CVE-2026-130774 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a n...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability: rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container makes it boot without a user namespace. Root processes inside the container run as host uid 0, keeping capabilities like sys_module, with no device cgroup restriction, letting them load kernel modules and compromise the host.

items.title: CVE-2026-130773 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted proje...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an authorization bypass that allows restricted project users to create resources in the unrestricted default project by targeting projects lacking features.* flags. Attackers can create bridge networks with raw.dnsmasq dhcp-script injection to run scripts as root, or custom volumes with block.create_options mkfs arguments to read host files.

items.title: CVE-2026-130772 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows ...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows restricted TLS clients to read other projects' bucket S3 keys and profile configuration through recursive and all-projects responses. Attackers can query bucket listings with recursion=2 or profiles with all-projects=true to obtain S3 secret keys and sensitive environment, cloud-init and user values across projects.

items.title: CVE-2026-130771 - Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in bac...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 fails to reject special files, hard links, or symlinks in backup or image metadata, allowing restricted project users to read or overwrite host files. Attackers can import crafted backups containing device nodes, a hard-linked backup.yaml, or symlinks to corrupt host storage, overwrite host files, or leak other projects' data.

items.title: CVE-2026-130770 - Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration an...
items.body: Incus before 7.6.0 creates the NBD servers used for virtual machine migration and disk export on abstract unix sockets, which have no permission checks and whose names are visible in /proc/net/unix. A local unprivileged user can connect while an operation runs to read or modify the VM disk, gaining code execution in the guest on a migration's receiving side.

items.title: CVE-2026-130769 - Incus before 7.6.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows client...

Attackers can trigger an unrecovered nil pointer dereference during configuration rewrite, terminating the daemon and all containers and virtual machines on the node.

items.body: The Groundhogg plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' merge-tag of the [ghr] shortcode in versions up to, and including, 4.10 The post_title replacement is registered with 'nested' => true, so the nested branch of Replacements::do_replacement() returns the merge value through tackle_replacements() without passing it through escape_merge_tags()/escape_shortcodes(); the callback single_post() calls html_entity_decode(get_the_title(), ENT_QUOTES), converting the entity-encoded text that wp_filter_kses leaves intact on a Contributor's post title back into raw HTML, which is then emitted into the rendered post. items.body: The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend Post Submission plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.14 via the `draft_post()` function. This is due to the function storing the `post_content` parameter via `wp_insert_post()` without the protected-shortcode allow-list check that was introduced in 4.3.14 for the sibling `submit_post()` handler — a gap that `wp_kses` filtering does not close, as it strips only HTML tags while leaving shortcode text such as `[wpuf-registration role="editor"]` intact. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to embed a registration shortcode in a post and cause any site visitor who subsequently registers through the rendered form to receive Editor-level access. The render-time `wpuf_modify_shortcodes` filter that is designed to neutralize protected shortcodes provides no protection here because posts created via the `wpuf_draft_post` AJAX endpoint carry no `_edit_last` post meta, causing the filter to return the content unchanged and allowing the shortcode to render and execute fully.

items.title: CVE-2026-119220 - The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your ...
items.body: The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your Own Amazon, eBay, Etsy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3. The vulnerability exists because the `matches_mcp_endpoint()` function applies an unanchored regular expression (`#/(?:woocommerce|dokan)/mcp(?:/|$)#`) against the entire `REQUEST_URI` including the query string, meaning any request that contains the literal substring `/dokan/mcp/` or `/woocommerce/mcp/` anywhere in its URI — including inside a query parameter value — is incorrectly treated as a trusted internal MCP context, causing `scope_product_permissions()` to unconditionally return `true` on WooCommerce's `woocommerce_rest_check_permissions` filter regardless of whether the caller is authenticated. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read full authenticated WooCommerce REST product records for any published product — including private underscore-prefixed meta, purchase notes, downloadable file URLs for paid digital products, catalog-hidden products, and edit-context representations — across the `/wc/v1`, `/wc/v2`, `/wc/v3`, and `/wc-analytics` REST namespaces. The bypass is triggered by appending a query parameter whose value contains the literal string `/dokan/mcp/` to any WooCommerce REST product endpoint (e.g., `/wp-json/wc/v3/products/{id}?x=/dokan/mcp/`); note that percent-encoding the slashes prevents the bypass, as the unencoded literal slash characters are required for the regex to match.

If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. items.title: CVE-2026-132069 - MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) contains an authorization bypass in ...
items.body:
MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) contains an authorization bypass in the SharingGroup model's captureSGExisting method. The authorization check used a logical AND condition that effectively exempted users with the sync permission (perm_sync) from the membership verification. Specifically, the original condition 'if (!checkIfAuthorised(...) && !perm_sync) return false' meant that any user holding the sync role would pass the check regardless of whether they were actually a member of the target sharing group.

A sync user who knows or can discover the UUID of a non-local sharing group could exploit this flaw through the /sharing_groups/add endpoint or by embedding a SharingGroup object in pushed sync data. The attacker could rewrite the sharing group record to add their own organisation as a member or insert an all_orgs server entry for their MISP instance, thereby gaining read access to all events contained in that group. This exposes threat intelligence data that was intended to be restricted to the group's legitimate members.

The vulnerability requires an authenticated account with the sync role and knowledge of a valid sharing group UUID. No user interaction is required. The impact is unauthorized disclosure of shared threat intelligence events and limited integrity modification of the sharing group record.

items.title: CVE-2026-110486 - In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `pro...
items.body: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

items.title: CVE-2026-19707 - A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0)  allows attacker-con...
items.body:
A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0)  allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. The issue has been fixed in Airlock Gateway version 8.5.3 and 8.6.1.

For an attack to be executable, the Airlock Gateway needs to have 'Smart Form Protection' (or the corresponding expert settings) enabled on a mapping whose backend returns a response containing certain multi-byte HTML character references. The buffer overflow then happens during the parsing of that HTML response. Such a response can come either from a malicious or compromised backend, or from an otherwise trusted backend that returns attacker-supplied HTML, e.g. an application that stores and serves plain user-provided HTML files.

Successfully exploiting the vulnerability can enable an attacker to perform a DoS attack or, in the worst case, an RCE attack against the Airlock Gateway in front of the affected backend. Compromising the functionality of the Airlock Gateway could in this way also affect the availability and protection of other well-intentioned backends deployed behind the same Gateway.

items.title: CVE-2026-130644 - A path traversal flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection wi...
items.body: A path traversal flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection with ansible-galaxy collection install, the install destination directory is derived from the namespace and name fields declared inside the collection artifact's own metadata, which are not validated as well-formed collection identifiers or checked for path containment. A malicious collection artifact -- delivered as a local file, a remote URL, a source directory, a git repository, or as a dependency -- can use a crafted name value to redirect the install destination outside the configured collections path, causing ansible-galaxy to delete an existing directory writable by the invoking user and then write attacker-controlled files to that location.

items.title: CVE-2026-130121 - The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for Word...
items.body: The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via AI-generated comment replies in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.28 due to insufficient sanitization of the AI model's output in the insert_comment_reply_logic() function, which saves replies with wp_insert_comment() and bypasses the kses filtering WordPress normally applies to comment content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page, by submitting a comment that leads the AI model to reproduce an HTML payload in its automated reply. This is only exploitable when an administrator has configured a Comment Auto-Reply automation task with 'Action on reply' set to 'Approve' (the default is 'Hold for moderation'), and the attacker's comment has been approved.

items.title: CVE-2026-110307 - An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Ser...
items.body: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

items.title: CVE-2026-106096 - A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, ...
items.body: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

items.title: CVE-2026-105929 - A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-gala...
items.body: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

items.body: FreeSWITCH is a Software Defined Telecom Stack enabling the digital transformation from proprietary telecom switches to a software implementation that runs on any commodity hardware.
